'''D4-V3''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] available during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The D4-V3 Astromech Droid is a droid pet granted to players who joined ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' through RAPTR.com and received a referral reward.<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
